basic_info.description: Tucked away on one of Hayes Valley's most beloved and picturesque streets, this rare single-family home offers two bedrooms and two full baths across two thoughtfully designed levels. The upper level features high ceilings, hardwood floors, period details, and multiple skylights that fill the space with natural light capturing the quintessential San Francisco vibe. Renovated bathrooms and a modernized kitchen ensure move-in readiness, while flower boxes and an updated faade enhance the home's curb appeal. Enjoy the convenience of a private garage with one-car parking, in-home washer/dryer, and extra storage. Located in the heart of San Francisco's popular Hayes Valley, enjoy great shops, restaurants, nightlife, and public transit right in your own neighborhood.
